Question Choices: There are 3 groups of 6 sheep. How many sheep are there in total? 6 + 6 + 6 = __
Hints: Think of adding 6 three times. You can also skip-count: 6, 12, 18.
Solution: Three groups of six sheep mean 6+6+6 = 18 sheep.

Question Choices: Fill: There are 6 in each group and 5 groups. Write number of groups first: Total = __ x __
Hints: number of groups x size of group
Solution: There are 5 groups with 6 in each group. Using number of groups times group size, write 5 x 6. Fill 5, 6; the total is 30.

Hints: "4 groups of 5" means four 5s added together.

Hints: The six blanks represent six groups of four. Write 4 in each blank.
Solution: Six groups of four mean six addends of four: 4+4+4+4+4+4. Fill each of the six blanks with 4.

Hints: This is 7 bags with 7 apples each, so it is 7 x 7 or 7 + 7 + 7 + 7 + 7 + 7 +7
